title: Accessible Form Component Library with Keyboard Tests
description: Builds a small set of form inputs, selects and error messages that work with keyboard and screen readers, and documents each accessibility decision with automated and manual test results.

title: Static Site Generator in Go for a Personal Blog
description: Converts Markdown files with front matter into a themed static website with tag pages and an RSS feed, then compares build time and page weight against an off-the-shelf generator.

title: Real-Time Collaborative Whiteboard with CRDTs
description: Implements shared drawing where simultaneous edits from many users converge without a central lock, using a conflict-free data type, and tests convergence under delay, loss and reordered messages.

title: GraphQL API for a Course Timetable with Query Cost Limits
description: Exposes timetable data through a typed GraphQL schema, prevents expensive nested queries with depth and cost limits and compares request counts with an equivalent REST design.

title: Server-Rendered Web App with Django and HTMX
description: Builds a task tracker that updates parts of the page through HTML fragments instead of a single-page framework, and compares code size and interaction speed against a React version.

title: Rust Web Service for a Library Catalogue with Typed Errors
description: Implements a catalogue API in Rust with compile-time checked queries and a typed error model, and measures throughput and memory against the same service written in a scripting language.

title: Content Security Policy Builder and Violation Dashboard
description: Helps developers draft a strict content security policy for an existing site by observing report-only violations, then charts which directives block which resources and suggests tightening steps.

title: Internationalised Event Page with Right-to-Left Support
description: Produces an event site in several languages including Arabic, handling plural rules, date formats and mirrored layouts, and checks every screen with automated visual comparisons.

title: Micro-Frontend Dashboard with Independent Deployments
description: Splits a dashboard into separately built and deployed parts loaded at runtime, shares authentication safely and measures the cost in bundle size against a single application.
